correctness.rationale: For L=1,...,22 each indexed cyclic binary word is one of 2^L integer masks, with seven-bit cyclic windows even for L<7. OR of 128-bit radius-one masks equals universal coverage iff every 7-bit target occurs within Hamming distance one. Independent C++ enumeration checked all 8,388,606 candidates: no solution through L=21, precisely 132 at L=22. For all 132, checked 11 ones, 22 distinct windows, two extended dihedral/complement orbits of sizes 44 and 88 and target hit multiplicities 80 once and 48 twice; integer orbit representatives 141243 and 158331. This exhaustive finite check proves the precisely bounded census, not any all-order statement.
residual_risks: The exhaustive proof is confined to minimum length through 22; no all-order statement.
